prompts.description: Create lightweight i18n dictionary (lib/i18n.ts) with a t() helper, seeded with grocery-category and AI-disclosure strings
prompts.prompt: Create a NEW file lib/i18n.ts. Do NOT modify any existing component in this step. Import the Language type and useMealStore from @/lib/meal-store (Language is 'en' | 'ko'). Define `const dict: Record<string, { en: string; ko: string }>` seeded with EXACTLY these keys: 'grocery.category.protein' {en:'Proteins', ko:'단백질'}, 'grocery.category.vegetables' {en:'Vegetables', ko:'채소'}, 'grocery.category.carbs' {en:'Carbohydrates', ko:'탄수화물'}, 'grocery.category.dairy' {en:'Dairy', ko:'유제품'}, 'grocery.category.fats' {en:'Fats & Oils', ko:'지방·오일'}, 'grocery.category.fruits' {en:'Fruits', ko:'과일'}, 'grocery.category.spices' {en:'Spices & Seasonings', ko:'양념·향신료'}, 'aiDisclosure.badge' {en:'AI-generated', ko:'AI 생성'}, 'aiDisclosure.notice' {en:'This service uses AI to generate meal plans. Results are for reference only and are not medical advice.', ko:'이 서비스는 AI가 식단을 생성해요. 결과는 참고용이며 의학적 조언이 아니에요.'}, 'aiDisclosure.gotIt' {en:'Got it', ko:'확인'}. Export a PURE function `translate(lang: Language, key: string): string` returning dict[key][lang], falling back to dict[key].en, then to the raw key string if the key is missing. Export a client hook `useT()` that does `const lang = useMealStore(s => s.appPrefs.language)` and returns `(key: string) => translate(lang, key)`. Do NOT add 'use client' to this file — translate must stay server-importable; useT is only called from client components that already declare 'use client'. No `any`. Verify: npm run build passes and lib/i18n.ts exports both translate and useT.

prompts.description: Flip the app default language from English to Korean for brand-new users
prompts.prompt: Edit ONLY lib/meal-store.ts. Change the DEFAULT_LANGUAGE constant from `const DEFAULT_LANGUAGE: Language = 'en'` to `const DEFAULT_LANGUAGE: Language = 'ko'`. Do NOT change the Language type, ensureLanguage, normalizeUserProfile, the persist config, PROFILE_VERSION, or any other line. This intentionally only affects brand-new users with no persisted state; existing users keep their stored appPrefs.language through the persist middleware. Verify: npm run build passes; loading the app with localStorage cleared starts in Korean (appPrefs.language === 'ko').

prompts.description: Localize grocery-list category headers through the i18n dictionary instead of hardcoded English
prompts.prompt: Building on lib/i18n.ts from the earlier step, edit ONLY components/grocery-list.tsx. Remove the hardcoded `categoryLabels` object (keys: protein, vegetables, carbs, dairy, fats, fruits, spices). Add `import { useT } from '@/lib/i18n'` and inside the component add `const t = useT()`. Replace BOTH usages of categoryLabels: (1) the share/copy text builder around the .map that produces `${categoryLabels[cat.category] || cat.category}` and (2) the header div `{categoryLabels[category] || category}`. Replace them with t(`grocery.category.${cat.category}`) and t(`grocery.category.${category}`) respectively (template literals using the i18n key prefix 'grocery.category.'). Leave the icon map and the color/className map EXACTLY as-is — do not touch them. Verify: npm run build passes; in Korean the grocery list section headers read 단백질 / 채소 / 탄수화물 / 유제품 / 지방·오일 / 과일 / 양념·향신료, and English still shows the original labels.

prompts.description: Add an 'AI 생성' / 'AI-generated' badge to generated meal cards and the recipe view (Korean AI-disclosure law)
prompts.prompt: Korean law requires AI-generated output to carry a visible label. Edit components/daily-view.tsx (where meal cards and the recipe detail view render). Add `import { useT } from '@/lib/i18n'` and `const t = useT()` in the component (it already has `const language = appPrefs.language`). Add a small unobtrusive badge showing t('aiDisclosure.badge') in two places: (a) each generated meal card header, next to the meal name; (b) once at the top of the recipe detail view/section. Style the badge as a subtle pill using existing token classes: `inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-muted px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground`, with a `Sparkles` icon from lucide-react sized `h-3 w-3` before the text. Do NOT change meal data, swap logic, the status pills, or layout spacing beyond inserting the badge. Verify: npm run build passes; every generated meal card and the recipe view show an 'AI 생성' badge in Korean (and 'AI-generated' in English).

prompts.description: Show a one-time first-run notice that meal plans are AI-generated (Korean AI-disclosure law)
prompts.prompt: Korean law requires prior notice that a feature uses generative AI. Edit components/daily-view.tsx. Ensure `import { useT } from '@/lib/i18n'` and `const t = useT()` exist (add if missing). Show a one-time disclosure notice the first time the user is on the daily meal view: on mount, guard with `typeof window !== 'undefined'` and read localStorage key 'nutriplan-ai-disclosure-seen'. If it is NOT set, render a dismissible notice — reuse the shadcn Dialog/AlertDialog already imported in this file, OR a simple fixed bottom banner using existing token classes — containing t('aiDisclosure.notice') and a single confirm button labeled t('aiDisclosure.gotIt'). On confirm, set localStorage 'nutriplan-ai-disclosure-seen' = '1' and hide it; do NOT show it again on later mounts once seen. Use a useState + useEffect pattern; do NOT add the seen-flag to the Zustand store or change PROFILE_VERSION. Do NOT block meal generation or alter the meal flow otherwise. Verify: npm run build passes; clearing localStorage and opening the daily view shows the notice once; after confirming and reloading, it does not reappear.
